notes: Sales orders, shade stock, loading slip, TDS on purchases, Tally export, and much more from the phone.
list: Sales orders — book an order, send it over one or more bills, and see what is still to go
Shade / batch stock — which shades are in stock and how many boxes of each, on the computer and the phone
Loading slip for the truck — boxes, shade, square feet and weight, no prices
TDS on purchases (Section 393(1), old 194Q) worked out on every purchase bill, with a month-wise list and deposits
Rate list for each party — print, PDF or WhatsApp; that party's rate fills in by itself on their bills
Export to Tally — ledgers and entries for your CA
Phone: make the bill from a quotation, challan or order; goods back (credit note); pay a supplier; count stock with the camera
Phone front page: today's sales and collection, money older than 30 days, last 7 days, and money owed by 0–30 / 31–60 / 61–90 / 90+ days
Phone: WhatsApp payment reminder, rate list, change or cancel a bill, purchase bills and expenses
Phone app 1.2.0: app lock with PIN or fingerprint, and the last copy of your books when the computer is off
The computer stays awake while phones are connected
TCS on sale of goods is no longer added to bills dated from 1 April 2025
E-Way Bill screens removed — old bills keep the number they were printed with
Party statements leave out cancelled bills, so the closing figure matches the balance
